name: valve_overlap_timing
title: Valve overlap from crank-angle valve timing (TP5 exercise 2)
summary: Teaching exercise: inlet and exhaust valve opening/closing crank angles (TDC at 0 deg CA) of a four-stroke engine at rated regime and at idle. The valve overlap is the angle between exhaust valve closing and inlet valve opening around the exhaust TDC, also converted to a duration through the engine speed.

origin.course: ULiège MCI, TP5, exercise 2 (valve overlap). The source inventory also lists R. Dickes as collector of the MCI file set.
